title: Eric and Wendy Schmidt AI in Science Postdoctoral Fellows Program
institution: Michigan Institute for Data and AI in Society (MIDAS), University of Michigan
field: AI in the natural sciences, engineering and mathematics

compensation.evidence_quote: competitive salary ($81,000 annually for 2026-27) plus benefits

about: Two-year postdoctoral fellowship at the University of Michigan applying AI in the sciences, engineering and mathematics, with one AI mentor and one science mentor. This is the final application cycle; the priority deadline is 23 November 2026, with starts in August or September 2027.
requirements: PhD in any field, conferred before the fellowship start (August or September 2027) and received after 1 September 2022
Two U-M faculty mentors for the full 2 years: one AI mentor and one science mentor; a prior or current faculty mentor is ineligible
Biomedical proposals focused on disease diagnosis, prevention or treatment are out of scope
Fellows must work in person on the University of Michigan campus
Materials: CV, AI keywords, research tagline and blurb, research statement, Individualized Development Plan, Responsible AI statement, letters from both mentors

upskill.name: Domain Applications of AI I
why: "AI in the natural sciences, engineering and mathematics" -> "Scientific discovery: protein folding (AlphaFold), materials science, climate modelling"
skills "Artificial intelligence", "Scientific research" -> "Scientific discovery: protein folding (AlphaFold), materials science, climate modelling"
